report.title: Poros v0.1.4 · Four-device accuracy report
report.description: Application and microbenchmark comparisons from the retained v0.1.4 measurements. The main campaign completed 2,216 of 2,217 tasks. The M5 Max 256 MiB pointer chase reached the simulator time limit. The charts also include separately measured Matrix Walk and the extended M5 Max TRMM sweep. Hardware points marked excluded remain visible and are left out of accuracy statistics.
